Pull requests are **by invitation**. An unsolicited one will sit unreviewed —
raise an issue first and you will get a scope and a review path, or a straight
refusal. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).

If you were invited: name the issue that invited this change, and include the
tests, receipts, and DCO sign-off (`git commit -s`) the invitation named. Never
use a pull request for a security report; follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md)
instead.
